title: Te Whakapono Huna i roto i ngā Taiepa o te Whare Ariki
intro: I waenganui o tētahi kōti nanakia e kī ana i ngā mahi tinihanga me te whakapehapeha, kei te pupuri tētahi wairua mokemoke i tētahi mea ngaro morearea. I te taha o te mana me ngā whakawehi o te mate, ka mātakitaki tēnei pononga a Allah i tētahi karere e tū ana ko ia anake ki te whawhai ki tētahi emepaea. Ina huri te wahangu hei wāhi whakauru, me whakatau māia ki te kōrero i te pono me te mōrearea nui ki a ia anō.
clues: I noho ahau i waenganui i tētahi iwi mana nui, whakakake hoki, i whakakahore nei i ngā tohu a Allah.
I huna e au tōku whakapono mō tētahi wā i te wā e whakatakoto whakaaro ana te hunga i tōku taha mō tētahi karere.
I kōrero nui atu ahau, me te kī atu: E patu ana koutou i tētahi tangata nā te mea e mea ana rātou, Ko Allah tōku Ariki, i te mea kua tae mai ngā taunakitanga mārama?
I whakatūpato ahau i taku iwi mō te mutunga o ngā iwi o mua, mō te Rā Karanga Ngātahi.
I mea atu ahau ki a rātou he kuiti noa iho ngā whakaaro o te rangatira i mahi ahau ki a ia, engari ko te ao tūroa te kāinga tūturu.
I mea atu ahau: E taku iwi, whai mai i ahau, ā, māku koutou e ārahi ki te ara tika, ā, i whakaorangia ahau e Allah i te kino o ā rātou mahi whakatakoto whakaaro.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Āpu Rāhapi
Karauna
Ās-Samiri
Hāmana
Te tangata whakapono o te whānau o Parao
identity.answer: Te tangata whakapono o te whānau o Parao

trial.label: I aha ahau?
options: I kohia ngā taonga i utaina ki ngā tāne kaha
I hanga e ia he pourewa tiketike hei tiro atu ki te atua o Mohi
Nā te whakapono huna i tiaki i a Mohi, ā, i whakatūpato i taku iwi
I hanga he kuao kau koura e tangi ana
I ārai i te ara o te Poropiti, ā, i tawai i te whakakitenga mō te taonga
trial.answer: Nā te whakapono huna i tiaki i a Mohi, ā, i whakatūpato i taku iwi

location.label: I hea i huraina ai taku kōrero?
options: Te Āka i runga i ngā wai waipuke
Te Whare Karakia Tapu i Makkah
Te Kōti o te Whare o Parao i Ihipa
Te Ana o te Hunga Moe
Te Raorao Ngāhere o Madyan
location.answer: Te Kōti o te Whare o Parao i Ihipa

outcome.label: He aha te hua i puta mai i ahau?
options: I toremi ahau me te ope taua i te moana wehewehe
I horomia ahau e te whenua me aku taonga
I pā mai te whatitiri ki ahau, me te Thamud
I hurihia ahau hei makimaki mō te takahi i te Hāpati
I tiaki ahau e te Atua i te kino o tā rātou mahi tinihanga
outcome.answer: I tiaki ahau e te Atua i te kino o tā rātou mahi tinihanga

arabic: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ ۖ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
verse: So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment - (40:45)
